abstract:
Can tumor biology alone predict who will respond to immunotherapy? A biology-first model using Genialis Supermodel to infer tumor immune state predicted immunotherapy response on par with leading published response signatures. It did so without using any response data in training. Come back to see where it ranked and what it revealed about patient [...]

Can tumor biology alone predict who will respond to immunotherapy?

A biology-first model using Genialis Supermodel to infer tumor immune state predicted immunotherapy response on par with leading published response signatures. It did so without using any response data in training. Come back to see where it ranked and what it revealed about patient response.

Presented at SITC 2026. The poster will be available to download after November 7, 2026.
